messages:
monica-peopleops: Noticed an odd spike in 'final score' variance for candidates in SWE IC3 roles this morning. Calibration leads flagged that numeric totals don't match expected weighting. Seen since ~07:45.

zack-recruiter: Interviewers reported that the rubric sliders looked fine, but the aggregated score in the candidate timeline was off (e.g., 3x 4/5 -> total 8 instead of expected 12).

hao-data: Pulled a few example scorecards. Our aggregator uses weights from role_config.weight_map. The submitted scorecard payload includes: `ratings: [{name: "impact", value:4}, {name:"skills", value:4},{name:"culture", value:4}]` but the integration payload from ATS now includes `weight_key` on each rating: `[{name:"impact",value:4,weight_key:"importance_v2"}, ...]`. Our parser ignored weight_key and defaulted to old map, which changed totals.

ats-integration-bot: alert: scorecard.parse_warning count=42 in last 2h for role=IC3-SWE.

claire-eng: Sounds like a schema extension on vendor side. Quick fix: treat unknown weight_key as fallthrough to legacy weights and log a warning. Longer fix: accept weight_key and map to weights table (and add to role_config). I'll push a small compatibility patch.

ben-talent: Calibration team needs to know which candidates were affected so we can re-run buckets. Also need guidance for interviewers: if you see totals change after submit, do not resubmit; People Ops will reconcile.

hao-data: I can run a patchback to recompute totals for submissions in the last 24h tagged with parse_warning. Command: `python bin/recompute_scores.py --since 24h --filter parse_warning`. Will produce a CSV of before/after for calibration leads. Needs DB read/write approval.

monica-peopleops: Approving the recompute. Claire, timeline for compatibility patch?

claire-eng: Pushed PR #5019 with: (1) support for `weight_key` mapping to `role_weights` table; (2) graceful fallback to legacy weight_map; (3) added schema-compat unit tests. Canary deploying now.

ats-integration-bot: deploy: integration-service canary 1/3 -> health ok.

hao-data: Recompute scheduled at 09:00 PST (after canary) and will attach CSV to TICKET-RECR-3321. I'll also run a dry-run now to preview. Dry-run: 38 affected scorecards, expected changes in aggregate between +2 and +6 points.

monica-peopleops: Thanks. People Ops will notify calibration leads and hold any automated pass/fail tagging until recompute completes. Postmortem items: require vendor to maintain backward-compatible weight field, add schema-compat tests in our CI, and add a note in interviewer training: "Do not resubmit if totals change after People Ops reconciliation." Closing for now; reopen if new parse_warnings appear. :white_check_mark:
